WITH overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(HGB) as overall_hgb
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
),
patient_avgs AS (
    SELECT 
        ID,
        AVG(HGB) as avg_hgb
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
),
above_avg_patients AS (
    SELECT 
        p.ID,
        p.avg_hgb,
        o.overall_hgb
    FROM patient_avgs p
    CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
    WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.overall_hgb
),
cohort_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) as cohort_avg_hgb
    FROM above_avg_patients
)
SELECT 
    a.ID,
    a.avg_hgb,
    a.avg_hgb - a.overall_hgb as above_overall_avg,
    a.avg_hgb - c.cohort_avg_hgb as diff_from_cohort_avg
FROM above_avg_patients a
CROSS JOIN cohort_avg c
ORDER BY diff_from_cohort_avg DESC
LIMIT 10
